review: The Middle Little Brother Sinclair is the long awaited sequel to the controversial Middle Little Sister Don. For clarification, he does not fix any of the problems Middle Don has, but he does benefit from having Middle Don on his team. Similar to Middle Don, most of Sinclair's damage comes out of his Counters. At 4 + Sum of Envy Absolute Resonance his S2 turns into a Counter Skill and similarly at 6 + Sum, his S3 does the same. Middle Sinclair’s main gimmick revolves around getting as many Envy A-Res as you possibly can, and his team building revolves around having other sinners who have an abundance of Envy skills. However, he also has unique debuffs and buffs that puts him above Middle Don by default.
